answer_1.quote: We propose NVAGENT, a collaborative agent-based workflow for complex NL2VIS tasks, which decomposes the visualization generation process into manageable subtasks ... Extensive experiments ... validate the effectiveness of NVAGENT ...
answer_1.outputs: visualization charts (bar, line, pie, etc.) and corresponding VQL/Python code

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance using both rule-based and model-based metrics for quantitative and qualitative assessment. Invalid Rate, Illegal Rate, Pass Rate, Readability Score, Quality Score, ELO rating, and Pearson correlation are reported.

answer_3.quote: We assess MLLM-scoring by calculating the similarity of GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o with human-annotated scores ... GPT-4o-mini serves as the vision language model for readability evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Human Annotation. The annotation is conducted by 5 authors of this paper independently. These annotators have knowledge in the data visualization domain ... We provide them with detailed tutorials, teaching them how to judge the quality of data visualization.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given detailed criteria and scoring rubrics (e.g., readability score 1-5) to assess visualizations for validity, legality, and visual clarity.
